issue_request: FHIR-12397 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from DSTU2 asking Medication.ingredient to clarify that omitted ingredients do not imply absence, listed ingredients do not imply completeness, and both inactive and active ingredients may be specified.
initial_application: The request was applied in git-svn commit 6ef7a79e5d, which changed the Medication spreadsheet ingredient comment from the old active-ingredients-only wording to the open-world wording from the Jira resolution.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-36499 extended the same Medication.ingredient comment with compounded-product and fully-specified-product guidance while preserving the FHIR-12397 open-world sentences. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-12397 record.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml already contains the requested open-world statement in a build-scoped Medication resource, and the combined branch contains the same source text.
